describe.hint: Tell our AI what you're looking for, or write it yourself. You can always edit afterward.

describe.pitchPlaceholder: Help us make lending feel obvious.
describe.descriptionPlaceholder: What the role is, what you'll work on, and why someone should care.

screen.hint: Optional. Candidates answer these in the application form.

publish.title: Where should it go?
publish.hint: You can change this any time.

detail.confirmClose: Close "{title}"? The role disappears from the career site immediately. Existing applicants stay in the pipeline and you can reopen the role anytime.
detail.confirmDelete: Permanently delete "{title}"? This removes the job, all its applications, threads, and screening questions. Funnel and stage analytics for the role stay intact.
detail.reopenHint: Republishes immediately on the career site
detail.publishForbidden: Only admins can publish, close, or reopen roles.

description.title: Position description
description.pitchPlaceholder: What's this role in one sentence?
description.empty: No description yet. Click "Edit description" to add one.

screening.title: Screening questions
screening.hint: Custom questions asked when a candidate applies.
screening.labelPlaceholder: Question label (e.g. Years of experience with React?)
screening.empty: No screening questions yet. Candidates will only be asked the defaults.

intro.d: Get to know each other and the role.

team.d: Meet the people you'll work with day to day.

offer.d: We'll move fast once everyone's met.

process.title: Hiring process
process.hint: What candidates can expect after they apply. Shown on the public career site.
process.empty: No hiring process defined yet. Click "Edit process" to add one.

team.forbidden: Only admins can change the hiring team or lead reviewer.
team.leadHint: The recruiter who owns triaging candidates for this role. New applications inherit this as their reviewer; the lead can be reassigned per-application from the candidate profile.
team.title: Hiring team
team.hint: Workspace members involved in this hire. Team members can view the candidates for this job, add notes, and write debriefs on interviews they're scheduled into.
team.empty: No one on the hiring team yet. Click "Add member" to assign a teammate.

publishing.title: Where it's published
publishing.hint: Vellum syncs this listing across the channels you've enabled.
publishing.ossNote: External channels (LinkedIn / Indeed / Otta / HN) are toggles in the OSS edition — credential sync is part of the SaaS roadmap.
